'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Battle of Khartoum (2023–2025)|Battle of Khartoum]]
***[[Airstrike]]s are reported in the [[Sudan]]ese capital [[Khartoum]], while heavy fighting takes place in [[Omdurman]] despite a [[ceasefire]] declared by both sides for the [[Islamic holidays|Islamic holiday]] [[Eid al-Adha]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/6/28/air-strikes-hit-sudan-capital-despite-eid-truce (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Nagorno-Karabakh conflict]]
**Four [[Armed Forces of Armenia|Armenian soldiers]] are killed by [[Azerbaijani Armed Forces|Azerbaijani forces]] in the [[separatist]] region of [[Republic of Artsakh|Artsakh]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20230628-four-armenian-soldiers-killed-by-azerbaijani-forces-in-nagorno-karabakh-separatists-say (AFP via France 24)]
*Two students and a professor are stabbed and injured in a [[Gender studies|gender-studies classroom]] at the [[University of Waterloo]] in [[Waterloo, Ontario]], [[Canada]]. The suspect, a recent university graduate, has been arrested and charged. The attack is believed to be motivated by hatred related to "gender expression and gender identity." [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/kitchener-waterloo/emergency-alert-university-waterloo-stabbing-watsafe-1.6892506 (CBC News)] [https://www.ctvnews.ca/canada/student-charged-in-university-of-waterloo-stabbing-police-say-was-hate-motivated-1.6461495 (CTV News)] 
*A man opens fire near the [[United States]] consulate in [[Jeddah]], [[Saudi Arabia]], killing a security guard, before being shot dead during a [[shootout]]. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2329721/saudi-arabia (Arab News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Titan submersible implosion]]
**Debris from the submersible [[Titan (submersible)|Titan]] has been returned to land after the submersible experienced a fatal [[implosion (mechanical process)|implosion]] during its voyage to the [[wreck of the Titanic]] last week. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-66045554 (BBC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2023 Canadian wildfires]]
**Smoke from the [[wildfire]]s in [[Canada]] reaches the [[U.S. state]]s of [[West Virginia]], [[Tennessee]], [[Delaware]], [[Maryland]], [[North Carolina]], [[Iowa]], [[Missouri]], [[Minnesota]], [[South Dakota]], [[Pennsylvania]], [[Kentucky]], and [[New Jersey]], with the smoke also reaching the capital, [[Washington, D.C.]] [https://www.wusa9.com/amp/article/weather/dc-air-quality-canada-wildfires-code-orange/65-4fb35e5e-5e88-4fbf-bcd7-21b0ba150eb0 (WUSA-TV)] [https://www.kcrg.com/2023/06/27/air-quality-suffering-eastern-iowa-canadian-wildfire-smoke/ (KCRG-TV)] [https://abcnews.go.com/amp/US/live-updates/canada-wildfire-smoke-us-air-quality/?id=100434871 (ABC News)] [https://www.abc27.com/pennsylvania/wildfire-smoke-returns-to-pennsylvania-code-red-air-quality-alert-issued/ (WHTM-TV)] [https://www.wymt.com/2023/06/28/air-quality-alert-issued-canadian-fire-smoke-drifts-across-kentucky/?outputType=amp (WYMT-TV)]
**Smoke from the [[wildfire]]s in Canada reaches [[Portugal]] and [[Spain]]. [https://www.hoy.es/nacional/primera-oleada-humo-incendios-canada-cubre-espana-20230628121505-vi.html (''Hoy'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Canada–Iran relations]]
**[[Iran]] brings charges against [[Canada]] at the [[International Court of Justice]] for allegedly violating Iran's [[state immunity]] by designating it a [[Iran and state-sponsored terrorism|sponsor of terrorism]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230628-iran-takes-canada-to-un-court-over-terror-listing (AFP via France 24)]
*[[Mexico–Peru relations]]
**[[Chile]] assumes a temporary presidency of the [[Pacific Alliance]] from [[Mexico]] amid a diplomatic conflict which saw Mexico refusing to hand over the presidency to [[Peru]] due to the removal of president [[Pedro Castillo]] in December 2022. [https://www.reuters.com/world/chile-assumes-pro-tempore-presidency-pacific-alliance-2023-06-28/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Killing of Nahel Merzouk]]
**[[Riot]]s occur in several [[France|French]] towns following the killing of a teenager by a [[Law enforcement in France|police officer]] in [[Nanterre]], [[Hauts-de-Seine]], [[Île-de-France]]. At least 31 people are arrested, 25 police officers are injured, and 40 vehicles are destroyed in [[arson]] attacks. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/6/28/outrage-in-france-after-police-shoot-17-year-old-in-paris-suburb (Al Jazeera)]
*[[LGBT rights in Nepal]]
**The [[Supreme Court of Nepal]] provisionally approves [[Same-sex marriage in Nepal|same-sex marriage]], pending a final ruling. [https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/south-asia/article/3225947/lgbtq-nepalis-welcome-courts-milestone-marriage-decision (AFP via ''SCMP'')]
*The [[Swedish Police Authority]] authorizes a protest involving the [[Quran desecration|burning]] of a [[Quran]] outside the [[Stockholm Mosque]] on the first day of [[Eid al-Adha]], aligning with a [[Courts of appeal in Sweden|court of appeal]] ruling that deemed security concerns insufficient grounds for denying the request. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2023/06/28/world/swedish-police-grants-permit-for-quran-burning-protest-outside-mosque/1898209 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]
*The [[Criminal Court of Thailand]] [[Acquittal|acquits]] a [[student activist]] and four others of obstructing [[List of Thai royal consorts|Queen]] [[Suthida]]'s motorcade during the [[2020–2021 Thai protests|2020 pro-democracy protests]] in [[Bangkok]]. The group faced a potential [[Sentence (law)|sentence]] of up to 16 years in prison or [[Capital punishment in Thailand|execution]] under Thailand's [[Lèse-majesté in Thailand|lèse-majesté]] laws. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2023/06/29/world/thais-accused-of-blocking-royal-motorcade-cleared/1898257 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]
